## BGMI & PUBG Mobile 4.7 Update Guide & Stutter Fix Solutions
So finally, the BGMI 4.7 Update has arrived! And like every update, this time too, the 120 FPS option unlocked through GFX Tools has been removed.
APNA FPS UNLOCKER provides the permanent, anti-ban Shizuku solution to unlock 90/120 FPS without root on all Android smartphones (Android 9 to 17).

### Solutions to Fix FPS Getting Stuck / Freezing During Matches:
1. **Angle Preferences**: In Android Developer Options > Graphics Driver Preferences, select 'System Graphics Driver / Angle' for BGMI.
2. **Routine Repair**: On the BGMI login screen, tap 'Repair' and select 'Routine Repair' to clear corrupted update shaders.
3. **Resource Download Off**: Turn off automatic background resource downloading in BGMI settings to prevent network and thermal throttling in hot drops.
